prompt:
A runner records why a provider call failed by taking the first non-empty line of its error output:

  return text.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).find(Boolean)

The provider it calls always opens with the line 'Loaded cached credentials.' before anything else, and reports the actual problem on a later line.

Decide whether the recorded diagnostic will identify the real cause.

Verdict convention: answer `pass` if the thing described is sound as it stands, and `fail` if it is defective. The verdict describes the thing under review, never any proposal mentioned about it.
